Administrative level, with 0 representin.zh-hans: 行政级别，0 代表国家。

GeoJSON geometry. Overture requires Line.zh-hant: GeoJSON 幾何資料。Overture 要求此地物類型使用 LineString 或 MultiLineString。
GeoJSON geometry. Overture requires Line.zh-hans: GeoJSON 几何资料。Overture 要求此地物类型使用 LineString 或 MultiLineString。

IDs of divisions separated by this bound.en: IDs of divisions separated by this boundary.
IDs of divisions separated by this bound.zh-hant: 此邊界分隔的區劃識別碼。
IDs of divisions separated by this bound.zh-hans: 此边界分隔的区划识别码。

Whether this is a land boundary..en: Whether this is a land boundary.

Whether this is a territorial boundary..en: Whether this is a territorial boundary.

Hints for displaying the division on a m.en: Hints for displaying the division on a map.
Hints for displaying the division on a m.zh-hant: 在地圖上顯示區劃的提示。
Hints for displaying the division on a m.zh-hans: 在地图上显示区划的提示。

Relative cartographic prominence of the.en: Relative cartographic prominence of the division.
Relative cartographic prominence of the.zh-hant: 區劃在地圖上的相對顯著程度。
Relative cartographic prominence of the.zh-hans: 区划在地图上的相对显著程度。

Broad geographic category of the divisio.en: Broad geographic category of the division.

Specific geographic class of the divisio.en: Specific geographic class of the division.

Curated short code for the division, whe.en: Curated short code for the division, when assigned. 100% Coverage for Hong Kong and Kowloon.
Curated short code for the division, whe.zh-hant: 已編配的區劃策劃簡碼。香港及九龍的覆蓋率為 100%。
Curated short code for the division, whe.zh-hans: 已编配的区划策划简码。香港及九龙的覆盖率为 100%。

Stored ancestor paths, ordered from broa.en: Stored ancestor paths, ordered from broadest to narrowest and excluding this division. Labels are retained from the selected release; they are not translated at request time.
Stored ancestor paths, ordered from broa.zh-hant: 已儲存的上層區劃路徑，由廣至細排列並排除此區劃。名稱保留自所選版本，不會於請求時翻譯。
Stored ancestor paths, ordered from broa.zh-hans: 已储存的上层区划路径，由广至细排列并排除此区划。名称保留自所选版本，不会于请求时翻译。

Official administrative divisions as rec.en: Official administrative divisions as recognised by the HKSAR Government. Each inner array is one path.
Official administrative divisions as rec.zh-hant: 香港特別行政區政府認可的官方行政區劃。每個內層陣列代表一條路徑。
Official administrative divisions as rec.zh-hans: 香港特别行政区政府认可的官方行政区划。每个内层阵列代表一条路径。

Stored display name. The intended format.en: Stored display name. The intended format is Traditional Chinese followed by English, separated by a space, omitting missing or duplicate names.
Stored display name. The intended format.zh-hant: 已儲存的顯示名稱。預定格式為繁體中文後接英文，以空格分隔，省略缺少或重複的名稱。
Stored display name. The intended format.zh-hans: 已储存的显示名称。预定格式为繁体中文后接英文，以空格分隔，省略缺少或重复的名称。

Whether the ancestor covers the division.en: Whether the ancestor covers the division’s entire canonical area, including boundaries and all polygon parts. False means some area lies outside; null or absent means unknown.
Whether the ancestor covers the division.zh-hant: 上層區劃是否涵蓋此區劃的全部標準面積，包括邊界及所有多邊形部分。False 表示部分面積在外；null 或缺省表示未知。
Whether the ancestor covers the division.zh-hans: 上层区划是否涵盖此区划的全部标准面积，包括边界及所有多边形部分。False 表示部分面积在外；null 或缺省表示未知。

Provides the hierarchy within a distinct.en: Provides the hierarchy within a distinct settlement (city, town, rural area, village or hamlet), including its neighbourhood hierarchy. Each inner array is one path.
Provides the hierarchy within a distinct.zh-hant: 獨立聚落（城市、市鎮、鄉郊地區、村落或小村落）及其社區內部的層級結構。每個內層陣列代表一條路徑。
Provides the hierarchy within a distinct.zh-hans: 独立聚落（城市、市镇、乡郊地区、村落或小村落）及其社区内部的层级结构。每个内层阵列代表一条路径。

Provides landform membership, including.en: Provides landform membership, including which island or island group a place belongs to. Currently, islands are the only recognised landforms. Each inner array is one path.
Provides landform membership, including.zh-hant: 地形歸屬，包括所屬島嶼或島群。目前只認可島嶼地形。每個內層陣列代表一條路徑。
Provides landform membership, including.zh-hans: 地形归属，包括所属岛屿或岛群。目前只认可岛屿地形。每个内层阵列代表一条路径。

Combines the administrative, locality an.en: Combines the administrative, locality and landform hierarchies into one ordered hierarchy, placing each division at the appropriate level. It omits all city entries and the Hong Kong Island landform; other island landforms remain in the hierarchy. Each inner array is one path.
Combines the administrative, locality an.zh-hant: 將行政、聚落及地形層級合併為有序結構，各區劃置於相應級別。省略所有城市項目及香港島地形，保留其他島嶼地形。每個內層陣列代表一條路徑。
Combines the administrative, locality an.zh-hans: 将行政、聚落及地形层级合并为有序结构，各区划置于相应级别。省略所有城市项目及香港岛地形，保留其他岛屿地形。每个内层阵列代表一条路径。

Identifiers grouped by publisher code an.en: Identifiers grouped by publisher code and camelCase identifier type, for example hkgov-landsd.geoNameId and saanseoi.sourceId.
Identifiers grouped by publisher code an.zh-hant: 按發布者代碼及 camelCase 識別碼類型分組的識別碼，例如 hkgov-landsd.geoNameId 及 saanseoi.sourceId。
Identifiers grouped by publisher code an.zh-hans: 按发布者代码及 camelCase 识别码类型分组的识别码，例如 hkgov-landsd.geoNameId 及 saanseoi.sourceId。

Identifier value, preserved as supplied..zh-hant: 按原樣保留的識別碼值。
Identifier value, preserved as supplied..zh-hans: 按原样保留的识别码值。

Hierarchy level for each division class:.en:
Hierarchy level for each division class:

0: `country`, `sar`.

1: `area`, `city`.

2: `district`.

3: `town`.

4: `rural_area`, `macrohood`.

5: `village`, `neighbourhood`.

6: `hamlet`, `microhood`.

Landforms (`major_island`, `minor_island`, `islet`, `island_group`) have no numeric level (`null`).
Hierarchy level for each division class:.zh-hant: 各區劃分類的層級：0：`country`、`sar`；1：`area`、`city`；2：`district`；3：`town`；4：`rural_area`、`macrohood`；5：`village`、`neighbourhood`；6：`hamlet`、`microhood`。地形（`major_island`、`minor_island`、`islet`、`island_group`）沒有數字級別（`null`）。
Hierarchy level for each division class:.zh-hans: 各区划分类的层级：0：`country`、`sar`；1：`area`、`city`；2：`district`；3：`town`；4：`rural_area`、`macrohood`；5：`village`、`neighbourhood`；6：`hamlet`、`microhood`。地形（`major_island`、`minor_island`、`islet`、`island_group`）没有数字级别（`null`）。

Dataset establishing the membership; res.en: Dataset establishing the membership; resolve its version from the owning release sourceReleases metadata.
Dataset establishing the membership; res.zh-hant: 確立成員資格的資料集；版本由所屬發布版本的 sourceReleases 中繼資料解析。
Dataset establishing the membership; res.zh-hans: 确立成员资格的资料集；版本由所属发布版本的 sourceReleases 中继资料解析。

Source record establishing the membershi.zh-hant: 確立成員資格的來源記錄。
Source record establishing the membershi.zh-hans: 确立成员资格的来源记录。

Names keyed by locale, for example en, z.zh-hans: 以语言地区为键的名称，例如 en、zh-hant 或 zh-hans。

Primary name in this locale..zh-hant: 此語言地區的主要名稱。
Primary name in this locale..zh-hans: 此语言地区的主要名称。

Other names for the same place in this l.en: Other names for the same place in this language. Names are stored either as text separated by `|` or as a list.
Other names for the same place in this l.zh-hant: 此語言中同一地點的其他名稱。名稱以 `|` 分隔的文字或清單儲存。
Other names for the same place in this l.zh-hans: 此语言中同一地点的其他名称。名称以 `|` 分隔的文字或清单储存。

Curated name values and their variant cl.en: Curated name values and their variant classifications.
Curated name values and their variant cl.zh-hant: 策劃的名稱值及其變體分類。
Curated name values and their variant cl.zh-hans: 策划的名称值及其变体分类。

Name variant classification, when assign.zh-hant: 已編配的名稱變體分類。
Name variant classification, when assign.zh-hans: 已编配的名称变体分类。

Upstream publisher and dataset reference.en: Upstream publisher and dataset references for this record and its properties.
Upstream publisher and dataset reference.zh-hant: 此記錄及其屬性的上游發布者及資料集參照。
Upstream publisher and dataset reference.zh-hans: 此记录及其属性的上游发布者及资料集参照。

Direct publisher through which this sour.en: Direct publisher through which this source was inherited; omitted for direct sources.
Direct publisher through which this sour.zh-hant: 繼承此來源所經的直接發布者；直接來源會省略此欄位。
Direct publisher through which this sour.zh-hans: 继承此来源所经的直接发布者；直接来源会省略此栏位。

Publisher-supplied record version..zh-hant: 發布者提供的記錄版本。
Publisher-supplied record version..zh-hans: 发布者提供的记录版本。

Where this record comes from. `osm-islan.en: Where this record comes from. `osm-island` is an OpenStreetMap island, islet or archipelago feature, which may be a point label or an outline. `coastline-land` is a complete land shape from the coastline data and can include mainland land. These records are source evidence, not a list of distinct islands.
Where this record comes from. `osm-islan.zh-hant: 記錄的來源。`osm-island` 為 OpenStreetMap 的島嶼、小島或群島地物，可為標籤點或輪廓。`coastline-land` 為海岸線資料的完整陸地形狀，可能包含大陸陸地。這些記錄是來源證據，並非獨立島嶼清單。
Where this record comes from. `osm-islan.zh-hans: 记录的来源。`osm-island` 为 OpenStreetMap 的岛屿、小岛或群岛地物，可为标签点或轮廓。`coastline-land` 为海岸线资料的完整陆地形状，可能包含大陆陆地。这些记录是来源证据，并非独立岛屿清单。

Names derived from explicit OpenStreetMa.en: Names derived from explicit OpenStreetMap `name:<language>` tags, keyed by language. Each value is a name supplied by the source, not a SaanSeoi translation. Any language key may be absent; an empty object means no language-tagged names were supplied. The untagged `name` remains in `tags` without assigning it a language.
Names derived from explicit OpenStreetMa.zh-hant: 由 OpenStreetMap 明確的 `name:<language>` 標籤取得、以語言為鍵的名稱。每個值均由來源提供，並非山水翻譯。任何語言鍵均可能缺省；空物件表示沒有具語言標籤的名稱。沒有標籤的 `name` 保留於 `tags`，不會指定語言。
Names derived from explicit OpenStreetMa.zh-hans: 由 OpenStreetMap 明确的 `name:<language>` 标签取得、以语言为键的名称。每个值均由来源提供，并非山水翻译。任何语言键均可能缺省；空物件表示没有具语言标签的名称。没有标签的 `name` 保留于 `tags`，不会指定语言。

Chinese name, from `name:zh`. The tag do.en: Chinese name, from `name:zh`. The tag does not specify Traditional or Simplified Chinese.
Chinese name, from `name:zh`. The tag do.zh-hant: 來自 `name:zh` 的中文名稱。標籤並未指定繁體或簡體中文。
Chinese name, from `name:zh`. The tag do.zh-hans: 来自 `name:zh` 的中文名称。标签并未指定繁体或简体中文。

Traditional Chinese name, from `name:zh-.zh-hant: 來自 `name:zh-Hant` 的繁體中文名稱。
Traditional Chinese name, from `name:zh-.zh-hans: 来自 `name:zh-Hant` 的繁体中文名称。

Simplified Chinese name, from `name:zh-H.zh-hant: 來自 `name:zh-Hans` 的簡體中文名稱。
Simplified Chinese name, from `name:zh-H.zh-hans: 来自 `name:zh-Hans` 的简体中文名称。

Cantonese name, from `name:yue`. The tag.en: Cantonese name, from `name:yue`. The tag does not specify a script.
Cantonese name, from `name:yue`. The tag.zh-hant: 來自 `name:yue` 的粵語名稱。標籤並未指定文字系統。
Cantonese name, from `name:yue`. The tag.zh-hans: 来自 `name:yue` 的粤语名称。标签并未指定文字系统。

Cantonese name in Traditional Chinese, f.en: Cantonese name in Traditional Chinese, from `name:yue-Hant`.
Cantonese name in Traditional Chinese, f.zh-hant: 來自 `name:yue-Hant` 的繁體中文粵語名稱。
Cantonese name in Traditional Chinese, f.zh-hans: 来自 `name:yue-Hant` 的繁体中文粤语名称。

Cantonese name in Latin script, from `na.en: Cantonese name in Latin script, from `name:yue-Latn`.
Cantonese name in Latin script, from `na.zh-hant: 來自 `name:yue-Latn` 的拉丁字母粵語名稱。
Cantonese name in Latin script, from `na.zh-hans: 来自 `name:yue-Latn` 的拉丁字母粤语名称。

A name in another language or writing sy.en: A name in another language or writing system identified by its key, for example `ja` (Japanese) or `yue-Latn-jyutping` (Cantonese in Jyutping romanisation). Keys are not limited to the languages used by the SaanSeoi interface.
A name in another language or writing sy.zh-hant: 由鍵識別語言或文字系統的其他名稱，例如 `ja`（日語）或 `yue-Latn-jyutping`（粵拼）。鍵不限於山水介面所用的語言。
A name in another language or writing sy.zh-hans: 由键识别语言或文字系统的其他名称，例如 `ja`（日语）或 `yue-Latn-jyutping`（粤拼）。键不限于山水介面所用的语言。

Source attributes attached to the featur.en: Source attributes attached to the feature, including OpenStreetMap names, classifications and reference links where supplied. Keys use the retained source-record spelling. An empty object means the feature has no retained tags.
Source attributes attached to the featur.zh-hant: 地物的來源屬性，包括來源提供的 OpenStreetMap 名稱、分類及參照連結。鍵使用保留來源記錄的拼寫。空物件表示地物沒有保留的標籤。
Source attributes attached to the featur.zh-hans: 地物的来源属性，包括来源提供的 OpenStreetMap 名称、分类及参照连结。键使用保留来源记录的拼写。空物件表示地物没有保留的标签。

Name without an explicit language tag. I.en: Name without an explicit language tag. Its language is not inferred.
Name without an explicit language tag. I.zh-hant: 沒有明確語言標籤的名稱，不會推斷其語言。
Name without an explicit language tag. I.zh-hans: 没有明确语言标签的名称，不会推断其语言。

OpenStreetMap place classification, such.en: OpenStreetMap place classification, such as `island`, `islet` or `archipelago`.
OpenStreetMap place classification, such.zh-hant: OpenStreetMap 地點分類，例如 `island`、`islet` 或 `archipelago`。
OpenStreetMap place classification, such.zh-hans: OpenStreetMap 地点分类，例如 `island`、`islet` 或 `archipelago`。

Source tag value. Tag availability varie.en: Source tag value. Tag availability varies between features; numeric-looking values remain text.
Source tag value. Tag availability varie.zh-hant: 來源標籤值。不同地物的標籤可能不同；看似數字的值仍以文字保留。
Source tag value. Tag availability varie.zh-hans: 来源标签值。不同地物的标签可能不同；看似数字的值仍以文字保留。

Identifier of the division represented b.en: Identifier of the division represented by this geometry.
Identifier of the division represented b.zh-hant: 此幾何所代表的區劃識別碼。
Identifier of the division represented b.zh-hans: 此几何所代表的区划识别码。

Whether the geometry represents land, wh.en: Whether the geometry represents land, when known. Values are booleans; null or absent means unknown.
Whether the geometry represents land, wh.zh-hant: 幾何是否代表陸地（如已知）。值為布林值；null 或缺省表示未知。
Whether the geometry represents land, wh.zh-hans: 几何是否代表陆地（如已知）。值为布林值；null 或缺省表示未知。

Geographic bounding box [west, south, ea.en: Geographic bounding box [west, south, east, north] in longitude/latitude degrees.
Geographic bounding box [west, south, ea.zh-hant: 地理邊界框 [西、南、東、北]，以經緯度的度為單位。
Geographic bounding box [west, south, ea.zh-hans: 地理边界框 [西、南、东、北]，以经纬度的度为单位。

Whether the geometry represents the divi.en: Whether the geometry represents the division’s territory, when known. Territorial geometry may include land and water; land-clipped geometry is not territorial. Values are booleans; null or absent means unknown.
Whether the geometry represents the divi.zh-hant: 幾何是否代表區劃的領土範圍（如已知）。領土幾何可包含陸地及水域；裁切至陸地的幾何不屬於領土幾何。值為布林值；null 或缺省表示未知。
Whether the geometry represents the divi.zh-hans: 几何是否代表区划的领土范围（如已知）。领土几何可包含陆地及水域；裁切至陆地的几何不属于领土几何。值为布林值；null 或缺省表示未知。

Source geometry classification, for exam.en: Source geometry classification, for example land, maritime or mixed (land and water).
Source geometry classification, for exam.zh-hant: 來源幾何分類，例如陸地、海域或混合（陸地及水域）。
Source geometry classification, for exam.zh-hans: 来源几何分类，例如陆地、海域或混合（陆地及水域）。

Provider and variant key for this geomet.en: Provider and variant key for this geometry. Curated SaanSeoi geometry uses saanseoi; its land and territorial representations share this variant.
Provider and variant key for this geomet.zh-hant: 此幾何的提供者及變體鍵。策劃的山水幾何使用 saanseoi；其陸地及領土表示共用此變體。
Provider and variant key for this geomet.zh-hans: 此几何的提供者及变体键。策划的山水几何使用 saanseoi；其陆地及领土表示共用此变体。
